snippet.title: Angels Online Global Launches in June 2026, Celebrating the Series’ 20th Anniversary!
snippet.description:
Angels Online Global launches worldwide in summer 2026 on PC and Steam, celebrating 20 years of the beloved series. The new international edition brings players from around the world together on shared servers, with real time chat translation enabling seamless cross language communication.

Ahead of launch, the global pre launch campaign “Back to the Angel Academy” begins in March alongside the opening of the official website. Register to receive exclusive rewards and stay up to date with the latest news.

✨Official Website👉 https://aog.userjoy.com/
✨Steam👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4018020/
✨Facebook👉 https://www.facebook.com/aog.userjoy
